# Coding Guidelines

Small function guidelines: functions should be small and readable.
Use clear names.
Avoid mixing unrelated responsibilities in one function.

# Function Noise

function function function function function function

# Token Noise

token token token token token token token token

# Security Policy

Token expiration policy: tokens must be signed and must expire.
Credentials must not be hardcoded in source code.
Debug mode must be disabled in production.
